required_events.event: Amy stirs eggs on stove while Will and Amber laugh over sizzling pancakes, filling the house with ordinary morning sounds.
A groan splits the air as a zombie rattles the front door; Amy grabs Will and Amber by their hands and shoves them into the back bedroom closet, slamming it shut behind her.

She rushes to the kitchen, then slips into the pantry to pull out her hidden arsenal—a pistol tucked beneath the flour bin and a katana stored in a drawer beside the stove—checking each weapon before stepping outside again.
As she steps through the front door, a zombie lunges at her; Amy fires the pistol, its shot echoing through the hallway and sending the creature staggering to a wet thud.
Another zombie surges from the living room, and with swift motion Amy slices it cleanly in half using the katana.
A third zombie appears behind the pantry door; she tosses her gun again, killing it before it can reach her.

More zombies keep coming one after another, each falling to either bullet or blade as Amy moves swiftly between them, turning the kitchen into a battlefield of clanging metal and splattering blood without faltering.

When the last zombie collapses beside the fridge, Amy slips back through the closet door, finds Will and Amber huddled inside with wide eyes, and together they step out into the hallway breathing the cool air of safety as the house settles around them.

phases.required_end_state: End at the expanded story's stated conclusion.
